sn35.134:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakyesu viharati devadahannāma sakyānaṃ nigamo.
sn35.134:1.3: nāhaṃ bhikkhave sabbesaññeva bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi. na ca panāhaṃ bhikkhave sabbesaññeva bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu nāppamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn35.134:1.4: ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanā sammadaññā vimuttā tesāhaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu nāppamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn35.134:1.7: ye ca kho te bhikkhave bhikkhū sekhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānāva viharanti. tesāhaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn35.134:1.9: santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā manoramāpi amanoramāpi
sn35.134:1.10: tyāssa phussa phussa cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti
sn35.134:1.11: cetaso apariyādānā āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
sn35.134:1.12: imaṃ khvāhaṃ bhikkhave appamādaphalaṃ sampassamāno tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi …pe… santi bhikkhave jivhāviññeyyā rasā manoramāpi amanoramāpi tyāssa phussa phussa cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti cetaso apariyādānā āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ. imaṃ khvāhaṃ bhikkhave appamādaphalaṃ sampassamāno tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmīti …pe…
sn35.134:1.13: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā manoramāpi amanoramāpi
sn35.134:1.14: tyāssa phussa phussa cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti
sn35.134:1.15: cetaso apariyādānā āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
sn35.134:1.16: imaṃ khvāhaṃ bhikkhave appamādaphalaṃ sampassamāno tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmīti.
